Class Base

java.lang.Object
be.uantwerpen.fti.ei.geavanceerde.towerdefence.game.entities.Entity
be.uantwerpen.fti.ei.geavanceerde.towerdefence.game.entities.Base
Direct Known Subclasses:
J2dBase
public abstract class Base extends Entity
Abstract base class representing the player's base that must be defended.

The base is a stationary entity. Every time an enemy reaches it, the game loop calls takeDamage(int) — typically reducing HP by 1 per enemy. When HP reaches 0, the game transitions to GAME_OVER.

The J2d subclass renders the base (castle/fortress sprite or coloured shape) and may also draw a health bar above it.

    • Base

      public Base(Position position, double width, double height, int maxHealth)
      Creates a base at the given position with the specified maximum HP. The base starts at full health.
      Parameters:
      position - the position in game-world coordinates
      width - the base width in game-world units
      height - the base height in game-world units
      maxHealth - the maximum (and starting) HP

      public void update(double deltaTime)
      No-op by default — the base is stationary.

      Subclasses may override this for visual effects (pulsing, damage flash).

      Specified by:
      update in class Entity

    • takeDamage

      public void takeDamage(int amount)
      Reduces the base's HP by the given amount. When HP reaches 0 the base is marked dead and the game loop triggers GAME_OVER.
      Parameters:
      amount - the amount of HP to remove

    • repair

      public void repair(int amount)
      Repairs the base by the given amount of HP, capped at maxHealth.

      Counterpart of takeDamage(int): the player can buy life points back for gold.

      Parameters:
      amount - the amount of HP to restore
